summary: Rockfall and small avalanche struck roped group in Dead Dog Couloir, Torreys Peak; one injured; group self-evacuated; helicopters dropped SAR teams.
notes: Undisclosed number in group; one injured. | MERGE 2026-09-13 (run 302): Unofficial Networks reports the same 2021-06-06 Torreys callout - CAIC said it was more rock slide than avalanche; 4 of 6 rode the slide into a rock field and the group self-evacuated; two Flight for Life helos dropped teams in and all six were found with minor injuries. Count discrepancy noted (Alpine said 5, UN says 6); victim count left unchanged. Merged CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row ('Torreys Peak: 1 climber caught, 1 injured by rock fall', estimated date 06/06).
